card.name: Mid-clause in drug interaction effects
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of a clause describing how one drug changes another drug's behavior, such as half-life, binding, metabolism or exposure. Also a few general verbs-plus-object phrases like helped organize a strike.

modes.label: Drug interaction wording
modes.description: Words inside a sentence saying one drug alters another drug's levels, binding or metabolism.
modes.example: Spironolactone has been shown to increase the half<<-life>> of digoxin.

modes.label: Binding displacement
modes.description: Words like binding, to, or its after displace or inhibit in protein binding statements.
modes.example: Ceftriaxone can displace bilirubin from its binding<< to>> serum albumin, leading to a risk

modes.label: General helped/organized phrases
modes.description: Non-drug text where a verb of helping or organizing is followed by its object word.
modes.example: Feynman helped to popularize<< the>> subject through his books and lectures, most
